candidate_relations.reason: The long-standing deep thigh mass with cytologic anastomosing cords and single-file monotomous cells in prominent myxoid stroma supports extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma, not myxoid liposarcoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Different myxoid sarcoma subtype: myxoid liposarcoma rather than extraskeletal myxoid chondrosarcoma.
